literal_meaning: ঠোঁটে টেপা লাগানো (lips to tape or seal)
figurative_meaning_bn: মুখ বন্ধ করা, কথা না বলা
figurative_meaning_en: To keep one's mouth shut or remain silent
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গোপন কথা জেনেও ঠোঁট টেপা করল।
এখন ঠোঁট টেপা করো, পরে বলবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He knew the secret but kept his lips sealed.
Button your lip now; you'll speak later.
note: This idiom draws from the modern concept of adhesive tape to metaphorically enforce silence, reflecting everyday Bengali linguistic creativity.
